title: Threshold Calibration for Agent Anomaly Detectors: ROC Analysis on Synthetic Attack Traces

original_idea.body:
# Threshold Calibration for Agent Anomaly Detectors: ROC Analysis on Synthetic Attack Traces

**Problem:** Agent anomaly detection classifiers require threshold calibration, but no study has characterized the ROC curve shape for agent behavioral anomaly detectors using realistic synthetic attack traces.

**Direction:** Generate a labeled dataset of normal and anomalous agent traces (using open-source agent frameworks with injected attacks). Train a simple anomaly detector and plot ROC curves. Analyze how threshold choices affect false-positive rates in high-volume deployments.

**Why it matters:** In production monitoring, false positive rates directly determine whether security teams can trust alerts. Characterizing the ROC landscape is foundational for deployment decisions.

**Relevant context:** Exabeam Agent Behavior Analytics; standard anomaly detection methodology applied to agent monitoring.
